snippet.title: BIG DIG - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out BIG DIG on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4304900/Big_Dig/ 

Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! 

Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway across the Animal Republic!
